name: Daniel
source: A lieutenant of the Balbora Empire. Although gentlemanly, an enhanced human being with the power to manipulate gravity. Working at a food cart in order to give relief to the low-in-funds advance force, he's a handsome middle-aged man with a cigarette in his mouth.
